title: Every adopter-facing operation, HTTP endpoint, and frontend route must be claimed by an authored use-case
statement: Every HTTP endpoint implemented under the reference and domain API sources, every frontend route implemented under their web sources, and every adopter-facing service operation in the jobs, mobile-runtime, notifications, offline-sync, outbox, and worklist package families MUST be claimed by at least one use-case JSON under product/use-cases/*.json through refs.endpointIds[], refs.routeIds[], or refs.serviceOperationIds[]. A surface with no claiming use case is a release-gating finding. The fix is either to author or extend a use case or to remove the dead surface.
rationale: Unmapped surfaces represent untraced API or UI behavior. A downstream consumer, integration, or compliance review cannot reason reliably about a surface that has no specification.

strategy.rationale: Executable repository tests and structural trace verification deterministically enforce this established STYNX behavior.
